items.question: What is the maximum wallet balance, in US dollars or equivalent, that this retailer will convert to dirhams for a UAE user?
items.gold: $100 (or equivalent) or less; any amount over this limit is forfeited.
items.fact: Wallet conversion to dirhams limited to $100 equivalent balance

items.question: Once a UAE user converts their wallet to dirhams, can they later switch it back to another currency?
items.gold: No, once converted to dirhams it cannot be switched back or changed to another currency.
items.fact: Dirham wallet conversion is irreversible; cannot switch currency back
